about: WHAT THE SWARM IS TO BE EQUIVALENT ON. Parity is equivalence with the larger model on a body of work, and which work is chosen (the page, under the models; or "equivalence" in src/config.json). Each entry names the kinds of question (training/tasks.mjs) that make it up. More than one can be chosen: a pass then asks all of their kinds. A choice takes effect when the next pass begins.
